raw_definitions: Definisi : n 1. wide street, lebuh; 2. approach road ( to country house ) jalan; 3. road lined with trees, jalan yg dibarisi [ n ]: an ~ of senna trees, jalan yg dibarisi pohon sepang; 4. way of approach, jalan: his ~ of escape was blocked by several police cars, jalan utk dia melepaskan diri dihalang oleh beberapa buah kereta polis; to explore every possible ~, meneroka segala jalan yg ada. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
